# feint.tv — BRAWLVERSE (full)

> BRAWLVERSE is an AI-generated virtual boxing league: 8 original fighter
> characters compete in cinematic bouts with trash talk, storylines, fan voting
> and prediction markets. All visuals are AI-generated and labeled AIGC.
> Site language: English (primary) + Chinese. Currency: USD.
>
> This is the full version of /llms.txt: same key pages, plus the complete
> fighter roster, the Season 1 quarterfinals, and the full prediction-market
> explainer. Fight records are 0–0 for every fighter — no bouts have been
> settled yet, and no record is claimed here.

## What is BRAWLVERSE

AI-generated virtual boxing entertainment league. 8 fighters: IRON JAW, VIPER,
SLEDGE, MONSOON, VOLT, THE PROFESSOR, LA REINA, GOLIATH-7. Season 1:
quarterfinals (QF1–QF4), semifinals, championship. Free to watch; accounts for
voting, collecting and prediction markets. Sign-in via email, Google or GitHub.

## Fighters (full roster)

All 8 fighters are original fictional characters. Records are 0–0: no bouts
have been settled yet.

- IRON JAW — Heavyweight Brawler. Takes a punch like iron, hits back like
  hell. Street-circuit legend. Zero finesse, all thunder.
  Trash talk: "VIPER's gonna need more than speed when my fist rearranges
  his face." Profile: https://www.feint.tv/fighters/iron-jaw
- VIPER — Lightweight Menace. Coiled. Ready. Lethal. A counter-punching
  phantom — you never see the punch that ends you.
  Trash talk: "Jaw's got a chin of iron and a brain of rust. He'll wake up
  on the canvas." Profile: https://www.feint.tv/fighters/viper
- VOLT — Fan-forged · Elemental. A lightning spirit in gloves. Undefeated
  in thunderstorms. Refuses to fight indoors.
  Trash talk: "I don't dodge punches. I AM the punch."
  Profile: https://www.feint.tv/fighters/volt
- GOLIATH-7 — Fan-forged · Heavyweight. Decommissioned war mech, gentle
  soul. Has never lost — has never wanted to win.
  Trash talk: "I was built for war. I choose the ring."
  Profile: https://www.feint.tv/fighters/goliath-7
- LA REINA — Fan-forged · Luchadora. Masked queen of lucha. ¡Viva la Reina!
  Opponents don't stay up.
  Trash talk: "The crown stays on. You won't."
  Profile: https://www.feint.tv/fighters/la-reina
- SLEDGE — Demolition Brawler. Swings like a wrecking ball. Once demolished
  three buildings before breakfast. The ring is smaller.
  Trash talk: "Everything breaks. You're just next in line."
  Profile: https://www.feint.tv/fighters/sledge
- MONSOON — Muay Thai Storm. Elbows like typhoon winds. Fights best in the
  rain — brings his own.
  Trash talk: "You can't block the weather."
  Profile: https://www.feint.tv/fighters/monsoon
- THE PROFESSOR — Chess-Boxer · Tactician. Sees twelve moves ahead. The only
  fighter who takes notes mid-round.
  Trash talk: "I've already won. You're just catching up to move 14."
  Profile: https://www.feint.tv/fighters/the-professor

## Prediction markets ("betting") — full explainer

Fans trade YES/NO contracts (priced 1–99) on fight outcomes; winners pay 100
fight coins per contract. Prices set by LMSR automated market maker; early
sell-back allowed; 2% fee on winnings recycled. Fight coins are virtual:
no cash value, no withdrawal, no crypto exchange. Entertainment only, not
gambling. Geo-fenced: not available to mainland-China IPs. $AXON token is
never used in betting pools.

How a contract works:

- Price 1–99: the price is the market's probability, in percent.
- Buy Yes if you think it happens, No if you think it doesn't.
- Sell anytime before settlement — you don't have to wait for the result.
- Settlement: Yes pays 100 if the event happened, 0 if it didn't.
- A 2% fee in points applies to trades — points, never cash.

FAQ:

- How much is a Yes contract worth? A Yes contract is worth 100 points if
  the event happens, 0 if it doesn't. The price you pay, 1–99, is what the
  market thinks the chance is.
- Can I sell before the event ends? Yes. You can sell your contracts anytime
  before settlement at the current market price.
- What is the fee? A 2% fee in points applies to trades. It is charged in
  points, never in cash.
- Is this real-money betting? No. BRAWLVERSE uses virtual points only.
  Points have no cash value and can never be cashed out.
- How do markets settle? Match markets settle on the bout result; storyline
  markets settle on the announced storyline outcome. Every market states its
  settlement rule before trading opens.
- What is LMSR? LMSR is the automated market maker that prices BRAWLVERSE
  contracts. It keeps a price available at all times, so you can always
  trade — the price moves with every buy and sell.

## Refunds

Cancel anytime; access runs to end of billing period. Refunds only for:
duplicate charges, charges after cancellation took effect, or full-period
outages caused by us — request within 14 days via /contact. Fight coins and
prediction entries are never refundable.

## Support

In-site live chat (Tawk.to) or https://www.feint.tv/contact. Knowledge base
covers pricing, betting rules, accounts, refunds, availability and creator perks.
